description: Configuration for the unified reminder engine and mileage prediction. Garages can override per type in garage_settings.reminder_overrides. Implement pure logic in lib/domain/reminders and lib/domain/mileage with unit tests; scheduling in Inngest.

engine.scan_schedule: Inngest cron every hour at minute 5 (Africa/Accra): find due_items where next_reminder_at <= now() and status in (scheduled, due_soon, due, overdue).
engine.batching: Group due items for the same customer whose reminders fall within the same 7-day window into one combined message (template key 'combined_due').

quiet_hours.behaviour: Messages that would send inside quiet hours are rescheduled to the end of quiet hours (07:00) plus a random 0–60 minute jitter.

channel_routing.order: Use customer.preferred_channels in order. Default order: whatsapp, sms, push, email.
channel_routing.fallback: If WhatsApp status is not 'delivered' within 15 minutes or fails, send SMS. Push and email are sent in addition if the customer has them enabled (they cost little).
channel_routing.respect_opt_out: If a customer replies STOP (SMS) or blocks WhatsApp, set the channel off and log consent change.

engine.allowance: Before sending, check message_usage for the garage. If used_units >= allowance + addon_units, send only push and email, mark SMS/WhatsApp as 'suppressed_allowance', and notify the owner (once per period). Transactional messages (OTP, receipts) are always sent.
engine.status_flow: scheduled → due_soon (first escalation stage reached) → due (effective_due_date reached) → overdue (after effective_due_date) → completed | dismissed

actions.book_now: Opens /t/[token] booking flow pre-filled with vehicle and service; on booking, set reminder_messages.converted_booking_id and pause further reminders for that due item until the booking date + 1 day.
actions.renew_with_garage: Opens renewal flow; creates renewal_request; pauses reminders while renewal is in progress.
actions.update_mileage: Opens mileage form; creates odometer_reading (source customer_update); recalculates prediction.
actions.pay_now: Opens the invoice/instalment/statement pay page (/t/[token], purpose invoice_pay); completes the due item when the linked amount is fully paid.
actions.already_done: Customer selects reason (done elsewhere, sold vehicle, not needed) and optional new expiry date; marks due item completed or dismissed and schedules the next cycle if a new date is given.

engine.completion: A due item completes automatically when: a job using a matching job template is delivered (oil_change, general_service); a new insurance_policy or dvla_record with a later expiry is saved; an instalment is paid; a credit statement is paid.

oil_change.created_by: Delivery of a job whose template has creates_due_item_type = oil_change, or manual entry of a last oil change.

roadworthy.created_by: Saving a dvla_record of type roadworthy.
roadworthy.note: book_now here books a pre-inspection check.

instalment.created_by: Each instalment in a payment plan.

credit_statement.created_by: Monthly statement generation for each credit account on statement_day.

mileage_prediction.implementation: lib/domain/mileage.ts — pure functions: validateReading, computeKmPerDay, predictOdometer, predictDueDate, confidence. Recalculate on every new valid reading (Inngest event vehicle/odometer.recorded) and nightly for all vehicles with open mileage-based due items.

validation.unless: odometer_replaced = true (then start a new series)
validation.flag_action: Set status 'flagged', notify service advisor, exclude from rate until approved.

rate_calculation.result: km_per_day = Σ(w_i × rate_i) / Σ(w_i), rounded to 2 decimals

mileage_prediction.fallback: If fewer than min_valid_readings, use garage_settings.default_km_per_day[vehicle.usage]; confidence = low.

prediction.predicted_due_date: last_valid_reading_date + ceil((due_mileage_km - last_valid_km) / km_per_day) days; if already past, today

confidence.high: ≥ 4 valid readings AND coefficient of variation of interval rates ≤ 0.35

mileage_prediction.low_confidence_behaviour: First reminder for a mileage-based item asks the customer to confirm current mileage (template 'mileage_confirm') before the due-soon reminder.

nudge.only_if: vehicle has an open mileage-based due item

mileage_prediction.display: Vehicle profile shows: '≈ {km_per_day} km/day · next oil change around {effective_due_date} ({confidence} confidence)'.
